target: दोपहर के बारह बजे हम खाना खाते हैं।
reason: Textbook trivia fact ("it is hottest at twelve noon") in formal register (सबसे अधिक); nobody says this in conversation. Replaced with an everyday use of the same time-number pattern (बारह बजे).

target: क्या आप मुझे हिंदी बोलना सिखा सकते हैं?
english: Can you teach me to speak Hindi?
reason: "ठीक से हिंदी सिखा सकते हैं?" is awkward and reads as an implied complaint that the teaching is currently bad; no learner would open with it. Same सकना request pattern, natural phrasing.
Verbless fragment — missing the copula है, so it is ungrammatical as a sentence and clashes with node-01 (sentence-final है). Sibling starter cards hi-S-001..005 all carry a verb.

Bureaucratic passive (इस स्कूल को ... खोला गया था) is signboard/report register, not everyday speech. Rewritten with plain बना था while keeping १९५० so the card still teaches Devanagari digits (its grammar tip cites १९५०).
